question: Can any circumstance be entirely free from auspicious and inauspicious experience?
premises: Auspicious and inauspicious outcomes arise in experience.
What arises must be undergone by someone.
No situation is completely devoid of such experience.
inference: Every circumstance involves the experience of both auspicious and inauspicious results.
plain_english: Auspicious and inauspicious things must be experienced, and nowhere is one ever devoid of them.
